title: Penguin morphology — source-linked research demo
scope: All 344 records and all 8 columns of the supplied penguins.csv; NA/empty fields explicitly marked missing. No records dropped and no missing measurements invented.

tables.title: Penguin morphology measurements
tables.note: Full supplied CSV. Measurements retain mm and g; year remains an identifier/time label rather than a measured outcome. NA denotes missing in this prepared file. Species, island and sex remain categories.

insights.title: Three species, three islands, 344 records
insights.text: The supplied CSV contains 344 penguin records: Adelie: 152, Chinstrap: 68, Gentoo: 124. Islands are Biscoe, Dream, Torgersen. Recorded years are 2007, 2008, 2009. These are sample counts, not species population estimates.

insights.title: Missing values stay missing
insights.text: NA is interpreted as missing in this prepared dataset. Missing counts: bill_length_mm: 2, bill_depth_mm: 2, flipper_length_mm: 2, body_mass_g: 2, sex: 11. No imputation or zero substitution is performed. Numeric measurements are stored as exact decimal strings with declared numeric types; sex remains categorical.

insights.title: Adelie measurement summary
insights.text: bill_length_mm: mean 38.79 mm (n=151); bill_depth_mm: mean 18.35 mm (n=151); flipper_length_mm: mean 189.95 mm (n=151); body_mass_g: mean 3700.66 g (n=151). Means are calculated from nonmissing values in this CSV. They describe this sample and do not establish a causal species effect.

insights.title: Flipper length and body mass co-vary in this sample
insights.text: Pearson r = 0.8712 across 342 pairwise-complete observations. This pooled descriptive relationship can reflect species and sex composition; it does not establish causation. Inspect the two measurement columns and compare species-specific views before generalizing.

limitations: Prepared descriptive statistics are computed from this exact uploaded file, not generated live by an AI model.
Sample composition and missingness matter. Correlations are observational, not causal.
The CSV contains no citation or collection-method metadata; do not infer a study design from the filename.
